about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for tests/gauntlet/execute.py:run_tool_case's pre-case health ping (night1-robustness-triage.md item 2). rob-r11's single true hang left darktable wedged with no recovery; rob-r12/r13/r14/r15 each queued behind it and were scored as four MORE hangs, when they never had a chance to hang on their own -- darktable was already unresponsive before their own steps ever ran. A case that starts already wedged is `inherited_wedge`, never `hang`; a case whose OWN step is what makes darktable stop answering is still a genuine `hang`. Run by tests/intent/test_inherited_wedge_intent.py against the real `execute.run_tool_case`, with the bridge faked (tests/gauntlet/test_session.py FakeDt/FakeMcp) -- never darktable, never a live gauntlet run.
